title: When We Had The Farm — EN/SN/ZU (Chas and Wilma McIvor)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone female vocal duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Zulu heritage farm memory
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English — Chas]
When we had the farm the days started before the light
The cattle needed feeding and the fences needed right
Attention and the water pump required its daily prime
When we had the farm it was a different kind of time

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Pataiva nemunda mazuva akatanga usiku
[When we had the farm the days started in the dark]
Zvipfuyo zvaida kudyiwa, uye mipanda yaifanira kurindwa
[The cattle needed feeding, and the fences needed watching]
Pombi yemvura yaifanira kubatwa mazuva ose
[The water pump needed priming every day]
Pataiva nemunda nguva yaiva yakasiyana
[When we had the farm time was different]

[Chorus — English — Both]
When we had the farm, when we had the farm
The red dust in the evening and the stars without alarm
When we had the farm, when we had the farm
We were younger and we had no idea of the charm
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — Zulu, with English translation]
Lapho sasinepulazi, izinsuku zagala emini
[When we had the farm, the days started at midday — before dawn]
Izinkomo ziyadla, imigobo idinga ukugcinwa
[The cattle need feeding, the fences need watching]
Ipampu yamanzi ifuna ukuphrinwa nsuku zonke
[The water pump needs priming every day]
Lapho sasinepulazi, sikhumbula yonke into
[When we had the farm, we remember everything]

[Outro — All three languages]
When we had the farm… Patakanga neomunda… Lapho sasinepulazi
The memory holds — Yeuraikwa ichichengeta — Inkumbulo inanela
The gardens still growing
